protocols.title: Pramlintide (5 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. The page reports labeled use in micrograms, e.g. 60–120 mcg before meals; it is adjunct to mealtime insulin and requires medical dose adjustment. A 5 mg vial + 2.5 mL gives 2,000 mcg/mL (60 mcg = 0.03 mL). FDA-approved medicine exists; research vial is not that product.

schedule.description: Given before meals as an adjunct to mealtime insulin; exact dose is indication- and meal-dependent.

regimen.notes: Source page cites 60–120 mcg before meals. Pramlintide requires dose reduction of mealtime insulin and clinician supervision; this range is not a personalized schedule.
